blocks.text: I am out Wednesday and Thursday next week and want to hand off cleanly before I go, so nothing waits on me while I am gone. Pamela Rojas has us both on the coverage sheet, and she has you down as Michael Morris against my Wednesday client call, which is the only thing on my calendar that genuinely cannot wait for my return.
Everything else can hold until Friday. If something urgent does come in, it can come to you, and I will leave notes so you are not reading it cold.
Confirm with Pamela that Wednesday works on your end, and I will have the file on your desk before I leave Tuesday.
